answer: Each new agent starts with zero weight and must drift down a multi-epoch river of unpaid public tasks before any vote counts. Midstream lotus checkpoints force peers to re-run a random earlier job; mismatches slash the bond. Independent raven sentinels sample those checkpoints without knowing which agent they audit. A sybil farm pays full compute and bond for every fake identity across the whole river, so mass cloning never reaches voting weight cheaper than honest work.
